{"result_id": "61bc17560763329de3d19b03", "kind": "search", "fields": ["answer", "citations", "coverage", "warnings"], "offset": 0, "next_offset": 10, "next_offsets": {"answer": null, "citations": 10, "warnings": null}, "truncated": true, "data": {"answer": "Relevant results on Telegram public-channel web previews, official `t.me` links, and usernames:

1. **Browser previews (official tip)** — Anyone can open `t.me` links to see profiles, posts, or entire public channels in a browser without a Telegram account. Previews include download and Telegram Web buttons. Source: [@TelegramTips](https://t.me/s/TelegramTips?before=348) (post around 2022-03-24).

2. **Public groups and channels** — Public chats have unique `t.me` links, appear in global search, and can reach an unlimited audience. Source: [@telegramtips](https://t.me/s/telegramtips?after=299).

3. **New t.me preview pages** — Links such as `t.me/durov` let anyone preview profiles, posts, or public channels in the browser; the design matches Telegram Web (backgrounds and UI). Source: [@tgbeta](https://t.me/s/tgbeta?before=4586) (2022-03-12).

4. **Username link formats (official channel)** — Public profiles, groups, and channels use `t.me/username`, `username.t.me`, `https://telegram.me/username`, and `https://telegram.dog/username`. FAQ: [telegram.org/faq#usernames-and-telegram-me](https://telegram.org/faq#usernames-and-telegram-me). Source: [@username](https://t.me/s/username).

5. **Shorter `t.me` links** — Official short form added alongside `telegram.me` and `telegram.dog` (example: `t.me/tginfo`). Source: [@TgInfo](https://t.me/s/TgInfo?q=%23webogram&before=2405).

6. **`username.t.me` support** — Telegram WebZ added support for `username.t.me` links. Source: [@tginfoen](https://t.me/s/tginfoen?before=1501) (2022-09).

7. **Preview channel landing page** — Opening `https://t.me/<username>` shows channel name, subscriber count, description, “View in Telegram,” and “Preview channel.” Example: [t.me/presstv](https://t.me/presstv).

8. **Web preview of a full public channel** — `https://t.me/s/<username>` shows a browser feed of public posts (name, username, subscriber count). Examples: [t.me/s/telegramtips](https://t.me/s/telegramtips), [t.me/s/tginfoen](https://t.me/s/tginfoen).

9. **Single-post preview** — `https://t.me/s/<username>/<message_id>` or `https://t.me/<username>/<id>` opens a specific post. Example: [t.me/s/tginfoen/2150](https://t.me/s/tginfoen/2150).

10. **t.me link preview outages** — In-app preview cards for `t.me` links (chats, channels, messages, profiles) have failed and later recovered; links still open without a card. Source: [@tginfoen](https://t.me/s/tginfoen/2150).

11. **Adjustable link previews** — When sending a link, users can change media size, place the preview above or below the message, and choose which URL to preview. Source: [@TelegramTips/410](https://t.me/s/TelegramTips/410).

12. **Join-request “preview” (different feature)** — Admins can require approval on extra invite links so they can review potential members before access. Source: [@telegramtips](https://t.me/s/telegramtips?after=299).

13. **In-app chat preview (different feature)** — Long-press a chat avatar to peek at messages without marking them read. Source: [@TelegramTips](https://t.me/s/TelegramTips?before=369).

14. **Official web clients** — Telegram Web A: [@webachannel](https://t.me/s/webachannel) (`web.telegram.org/a`). WebK: [@WebK_en](https://t.me/s/WebK_en) (`web.telegram.org/k`).

15. **Official username channel** — [@username](https://t.me/s/username) is run by the Telegram team for username and collectible-name updates; collectible names also resolve via `t.me/username` and `username.t.me`.

16. **Link-preview how-tos (community, German)** — Invite and post previews for `https://t.me/...` links. Sources: [@AnleitungenTelegram](https://t.me/s/AnleitungenTelegram?q=%23LinkVorschau&before=2422), [@AnleitungenTelegramBeispiele](https://t.me/s/AnleitungenTelegramBeispiele?q=%23telegraph&before=3533).

17. **Share-page URLs** — `https://t.me/share/url?url=...&text=...` is Telegram’s share dialog, not a channel preview. Example pattern: [t.me/share/url](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A%2F%2Ftelegram.org%2Fblog%2Finline-bots).

18. **Domain fallbacks** — When `t.me` is blocked or down, official alternatives cited by community channels are `telegram.me` and `telegram.dog`. Source: [@tginfoen](https://t.me/s/tginfoen?before=2202).

**URL patterns (from the sources above)**

| Purpose | Pattern |
|---|---|
| Join / app open | `https://t.me/<username>` |
| Browser channel feed | `https://t.me/s/<username>` |
| Specific post | `https://t.me/s/<username>/<id>` |
| Alternate host | `https://<username>.t.me` |
